mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals weak consumer spending power, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 950 and GDP growth (GDPC1) above 15900 indicate robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 950 and GDPC1 > 15900 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 0.5% combined with CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 230 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index above 100.5 indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.5 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1000 units signal weak residential construction demand, reducing economic activity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) combined with low employment levels (PAYEMS < 137500) indicates labor market slack, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5 and PAYEMS < 137500 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above 420,000 and housing starts (HOUST) above 950 indicate strong consumer spending confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 420000 and HOUST > 950 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).
